reason: Publish #173, which pins an exact uv version on every astral-sh/setup-uv step so the five Gate Family workflows stop making an unconditional external call before any linter runs. At the pinned action SHA (11f9893 / v8.3.2) setupUv() calls resolveUvVersion() BEFORE tryGetFromToolCache(), so with no version: input the specifier is latest and LatestVersionResolver must fetch astral-sh/versions' v1/uv.ndjson from raw.githubusercontent.com under a hard AbortSignal.timeout(5_000) on every run, with a warm tool cache unable to prevent it. That is what failed Rubio-Enterprises/webfetch#106's lint-format job during the 2026-07-31 47-PR fleet wave: the step aborted on timeout and 'Render canonical lint configs' plus 'Run linters' were skipped, so a Gate Family required check went red before a single rule was evaluated. An exact specifier routes through ExactVersionResolver, which returns offline and makes the tool-cache short-circuit reachable. Deliberately not overclaimed: on a cold tool cache downloadVersion() -> getArtifact() -> fetchManifest() still reads the same manifest for the artifact URL and the action exposes no bypass, so this converts 'every run, always' into 'first run per runner per uv version' rather than eliminating the dependency. Gate Family surface of this transition is exactly that change: the audit, lint-format, secret-scan, pr-title and typecheck-ts blobs are byte-identical at f66ffb1 and at the pre-merge main tip, so #173 is the only commit in the published range that touches a ruleset-consumed file. The rest of the range is inert to this tag - #165 and #166 edit lint-hooks.yml, a thin-called reusable that consumers pin by SHA off the floating v1 and no ruleset reads from gates/wf-v1; #164 and #172 are a copier re-render and a plugin-carrier sync; and #169's deletion of test-py.yml and rust-test.yml is safe here because .github-private#169 destroyed the gate-python-tests and gate-rust-tests org rulesets first (merged 2026-07-31T00:57Z, three minutes before #169 here), and terraform's gate_ruleset_workflows now lists exactly the five surviving families that this repo's manifest lists. Candidate Validation judgment: a temporary evaluate-mode duplicate ruleset at the candidate is disproportionate for this change and was NOT performed. Three reasons. (1) The pinned value is not a version change - astral-sh/uv 0.12.1 is the current latest release (published 2026-07-31T19:43Z), which is precisely what the unpinned steps already resolve and install today, so the installed uv binary is identical before and after; the pin cannot introduce a uv the fleet is not already running. (2) The diff is additive and structural-free: each step gains only a with: version: input plus a renovate marker comment. No step is added, removed, reordered or conditioned, so there is no new execution path for an evaluate-mode run to exercise that the enforced run does not already cover. (3) The candidate step shape did execute on a hosted runner, in #173's own test-gate job (run 30711970985 series, job 'canonical tests', run id 30711970992): the log shows 'version: 0.12.1' passed to the action, no 'Could not determine uv version ... Falling back to latest' line, and a direct move to the artifact download - the exact offline-resolution behaviour this change is buying, observed rather than assumed. Residual risk is bounded and the rollback is cheap: a bad outcome is another request-only PR setting target_sha back to f66ffb1e8e1f51d55f7ae56b418e66176aa88b1a with expected_current_sha reread from the live ref.
